fusions.name: Passage Note
fusions.desc: Calls to an enemy up to 8 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 25%.

fusions.name: Breach
fusions.desc: Breaches and crashes down, which deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Surface Elsewhere
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Long Migration
fusions.desc: Every stretch of ground you cover restores 5 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
